QUOTE: `class ServerDataOperator extends mix(ServerDataOperatorBase).with(...)` applies each handler as a mixin, in order (`index.ts:40-54`). `mix` (`app/utils/mix.ts`) just reduces the list, so each handler is a class factory wrapping the previous class.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly states ServerDataOperator extends mix(ServerDataOperatorBase).with(...) and that handlers are applied as mixins rather than declared in the class.
